findings.explanation: This clause allows the client to request an unlimited number of revisions and alterations with no cap, and subjectively determines when the work is complete.
findings.suggested_change: The Contractor shall provide up to two (2) rounds of revisions at no additional cost, provided such requests are made within fourteen (14) days of delivery.

findings.explanation: Intellectual property rights transfer to the client immediately upon creation as a work made for hire, before you are guaranteed to receive payment.
findings.suggested_change: Upon receipt of full payment for the applicable services, all right, title, and interest in the final deliverables shall transfer to the Client.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hi, I hope you are having a great week. I have reviewed the agreement and would like to propose a few minor adjustments before signing. - Regarding the relevant clause on work completion, since an unlimited number of revisions is difficult to manage, I propose that the agreement be updated so that the contractor shall provide up to two rounds of revisions at no additional cost, provided such requests are made within fourteen days of delivery. - Regarding the relevant clause on intellectual property, to ensure fair terms, I propose that upon receipt of full payment for the applicable services, all right, title, and interest in the final deliverables shall transfer to the client. Please let me know if these adjustments work for you so we can move forward. Best regards,
